Sylvain Favardin
for Ludmila

Concept and texts

 

I believe that love should be celebrated more than just once a year, but at least 100 times more. When love strikes, one can’t help but to shout it to the world! To express this transcendent feeling to my other half, I wrote hundreds of love metaphors of everyday things that can’t exist without each other. Here is a selection of 100 declarations of love.

How it
Works

Scrollino® is the revolutionary concept of the rewinding book. A simple pencil is all you need to enjoy reading this Scrollino.

#col-544100920 > .col-inner { padding: 20% 10% 0% 15%; margin: -133.375% 0px 0px 0px; }


Scrollino® Dual Scroller

 

Interactive and eco-friendly

Scrollino is not only exciting and inspiring, it is also fully recyclable and compostable as we use high-quality organic materials. The box is made of FSC certified, natural feel acid-free heavyweight paper 130lb / 350gsm, for the rolls we use a custom-made paper perfect to be recycled, the Scrollers are molded from recycled wood, and our pencils are made of natural wood.

#col-2044757437 > .col-inner { padding: 8% 5% 10% 8%; }

#col-1750861403 > .col-inner { padding: 0px 24px 0px 0px; margin: 15% 0px 5% 0px; }

1. Insert the pencil & Turn

 

Make yourself ready to unwind

Scrollino® Dual Scroller has a dual-rewinding system (Scroller), a Scrollino box with a “viewing screen,” and a paper roll printed with love declarations. To start enjoying this Scrollino, insert a pencil in the top scroller and turn it clockwise to start playing. Continue turning the pencil until the end and write your own love declarations.

2. Scrollino love box

 

4.06 yards / 3.71 meters of love to reveal

Love should be celebrated more than once a year. Love is universal, it speaks to all at any moment. Expressing this feeling through metaphors on everyday things that cannot exist without their other half can be inspiring! In the Scrollino You Are, you even have the space to be inspired and write our own love declarations!

#col-766348426 > .col-inner { padding: 8% 5% 10% 8%; }

3. Rewind with a pencil

 

Pencil included

Once you finish reading, insert the pencil to the bottom Scroller and turn anti-clockwise to rewind. Each Scrollino comes with a wooden pencil. Did you lose the pencil? No problem, the Scrollino works with most standard pens and pencils (hexagonal, rounded, triangular, etc.). If you don’t have any handy, check your kitchen drawers or toolbox!
